# Why did Google reject my bulk location spreadsheet?

> Catch what breaks a Google Business Profile bulk upload, with the line number, before you upload. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
